title: A big house with a large second floor, white walls in the interior, no lights & a thing of haunting dread
content: It feels like someone else's home, by all means it is, I've never been in such a house in my life. But it's like I'm looking into someone else's dream, or in this case, a nightmare. For whatever's haunting the house is a reflection of my own fear. The lights are out, in the dark gloom there is a blueish tint. The walls are white. The floors are a dark & varnished wood, something to skid around. All the doors are closed. But in that hall, it begins to walk. Something that used to be a woman, but long dead. Not rotting. Haunting. Whatever features she had in life are gone, she is now just a husk. She comes up to the door at the end of the hall, which is our perspective from the top right corner of said hallway. She begins to make a sound outside the door, somewhere between a moan & an inhuman groan, softly at first, but it gets louder, & louder. I get the feeling that I can't be there to look at her, I can't see what's about to happen. If I look at it, this scene, something will happen. It needs me to look at it. I'm not sure if anyone else ever experienced this in their dreams. But I had it in another nightmare; the trick is to not get pulled in, don't look. No matter how much you want to get away, you can't. You'll turn your head & she - it - is there again. And its always in empty places. Like the household with white walls & no lights on, or like a public facility that's somewhere between a leisure centre with a pool & a youth club. Old buildings, big buildings, many hallways. You get caught up in trying to leave the location or an event goes on there, but you're left on your own instead of being able to leave with other people.
